allow: PowerShell(Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id, ProcessName, StartTime, @{Name="CmdLine";Expression={\(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId = $\($_.Id\)"\).CommandLine}} | Format-Table -Wrap -AutoSize)

PowerShell(Get-Process -Name node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction Continue; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500; Write-Host "Remaining:" @\(Get-Process -Name node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).Count)
